name: Export to Figma
tagline: Export to Figma is a Chrome extension that turns any live website into a fully editable Figma design in seconds
description: Export to Figma is a Chrome extension that turns any live website into a fully editable Figma design in seconds. It’s built to remove the repetitive step of recreating layouts manually and give you a clean, structured starting point directly from real interfaces. Whether you’re working on an existing product, exploring references, or iterating on developer-built pages, it helps you move from browser to design instantly — with everything preserved and ready to edit. Features: * Capture full pages
